scope: Content interpretation, colour, functions, forms, optional content and page transforms checked against the local ISO 32000-2:2020 sponsored EC3 text. Implemented transparency in clause 11, analytic/mesh shadings, shading and tiling patterns in 8.7, annotation appearances, generated link/square/note shapes and view flags in 12.5 and continuous-tone halftone bypass in 10.6 are covered by independent fixtures. Exact-area bytes, Bradford adaptation, sRGB output and rounding are project policy. ICC source admission, Gray/RGB matrix/TRC and forward mft1/mft2/mAB processing are checked against locally supplied ICC.1:2010 (v4.3); legacy v2 transform encodings are covered, but v2-specific metadata rules await a primary v2 text.

requirements.rule: Supported embedded source profiles use forward processing, never silent Alternate substitution. Gray TRCs scale PCS D50 XYZ or L*=100, not media white (ICC F.2); RGB uses the column matrix and per-channel TRCs (F.3). Sampled forward curves may be nonmonotonic and matrices need not be invertible. Parametric outputs clip, including positive overflow; threshold arithmetic preserves the nonnegative power domain. ICC Table 34 count-one gamma is two-byte unsigned 8.8 per 4.9; Table 65 is interpreted with complementary branches and the separate e offset for type 4 because its printed formulas conflict with its parameter list. Source values clip to ICC Range before Alternate, including later-version fallback; Alternate structure is validated even when unused. Bradford D50-to-D65 adaptation, sRGB output encoding, gamut clipping and final rounding are project policy.

requirements.rule: Mesh records decode coordinates and components, honour byte padding and reuse preceding edges. Triangles interpolate barycentrically; patches interpolate corner components bilinearly in their bicubic parameter space. Functions run after interpolation. Later patches take precedence; folds select largest v then u. Pixel-centre sampling, numeric root tolerance and byte rounding are project policies. Patch inversion uses a 2^-24 parameter subdivision floor and a 1e-9 tie tolerance for coincident v roots; these are project numeric policies.

requirements.rule: ICC.1:2010 v4 profiles validate BCD/version reserved bytes, Gregorian dates, permitted source class/colour-space/PCS, attributes, intent, D50 illuminant, MD5 ProfileID and reserved bytes; required tags depend on profile class/model. Tag bodies are tightly packed, aligned and zero-padded, with exact shared bodies allowed. XYZ records are complete and nonnegative, reserved type fields and curve extents are exact, and chad is a signed sf32 invertible 3-by-3 matrix. These v4 metadata rules are not imposed on legacy v2 profiles. All table products, extents, allocations and cumulative retained profile storage are bounded before use.

requirements.rule: Forward mft2 uses input tables, CLUT and output tables; its source-non-XYZ matrix must be identity. Forward mft1 uses 256-sample input/output tables and Lab PCS. mAB accepts B, M+matrix+B, A+CLUT+B and A+CLUT+M+matrix+B, including unequal grid sizes and 8/16-bit CLUTs. PCSXYZ uses unsigned 1.15; mft2 uses legacy FF00 Lab white in both v2 and v4, while mft1 and mAB use modern Lab encodings. Source Lab values use L* 0–100 and a*/b* -128–127 before normalization. Multilinear CLUT interpolation is project policy; two-point axes are linear as ICC requires. Evaluation uses at most 16 corners for PDF source profiles. Inverse mBA selected as a forward transform fails explicitly; optional BToA tags are ignored. LUT8 XYZ PCS has no specified encoding and remains explicit Unsupported.
requirements.status: implemented; ICC.1:2010 primary text verified
requirements.gaps: LUT8 XYZ PCS is implementation-specific and unsupported; inverse BToA processing; multiProcessElementsType DToB transforms. Image default Decode and Indexed-image palettes must use ICC component ranges in the image painting layer.

requirements.rule: PDF ri and ExtGState RI, saved/restored with graphics state, choose the designated source AToB intent transform, then AToB0, then matrix/TRCs. An unrelated AToB2 does not block relative matrix processing. Unsupported DToB elements may be bypassed under ICC 8.10.2(a). PDF ignores profile-header intent and inverse BToA tags. Absolute colorimetry uses the relative transform and scales by media-white/PCS-white. Unknown PDF intents fall back to RelativeColorimetric. The RGB output target and its adaptation remain project policy.

Caret normal appearance synthesis supports Sy None (including absent/null) and P with indirect values. Reader artwork is an original filled chevron and optional geometric pilcrow, scaled from a 16-unit grid to RD-inset bounds; both use a single nonzero fill with C (black default) and ca (else CA). No fonts are required. RD follows left/top/right/bottom order, requires four nonnegative finite values and positive remaining width/height, and preserves the original appearance BBox. The shared Square/Circle/Caret reader checks cardinality before resolving into fixed stack numbers and rejects extent/sum overflow. Geometry/work and output are bounded before empty-color suppression. Unrecognized symbols refuse explicitly; stored appearances retain precedence.

requirements.rule: When LL is present, L identifies the source leader endpoints. The line proper is displaced perpendicular to L by abs(LL)+LLO; the sign of LL selects the side. Leader strokes start LLO from the source endpoints and extend LLE beyond the line proper. LLE requires LL; LLE and LLO are nonnegative, and all coordinates and arithmetic must remain finite. Without LL, L remains the line proper and LLO has no leader to offset. Reader policy uses +x for directionless L, the positive side for zero LL, one shared stroke for the body and leaders with the BS dash pattern, and ending marks anchored to the translated line. Fixed stack geometry and bounded content retain the original annotation clip.

requirements.rule: Generate rectangular B (raised) and I (recessed) borders for Link/Square, plain FreeText and supported empty widgets. Device components are clamped then interpolated halfway toward white/black (reversed component direction for CMYK). Border facets use CA through scoped private fill-alpha resources even when CA is one; background/text keep ca. BS precedence, zero width, original BBox, stored appearances and bounded geometry/work/content remain explicit.

requirements.rule: Generate inert rich annotation text from RC text strings or XML streams and DS defaults. Parse bounded inherited styles and paragraphs, sharing PDF font encoding and ordinary appearance programs. Preserve stored AP precedence, clipping, opacity and source identity. Unknown XFA markup is ignored; external objects and unsupported known formatting fail explicitly.

Existing stored appearances remain preferred.

requirements.rule: Generate rounded rectangular legacy Border outlines for Link, Square, plain FreeText and supported empty widgets. Read finite nonnegative horizontal/vertical corner radii and border width; BS takes precedence without resolving unused Border, while null BS is absent. Reader artwork clamps each radius to half its centreline extent and uses two tangent 45-degree cubics per corner; either zero radius yields sharp corners. Square IC fills follow that outline; FreeText/widget backgrounds retain their existing rectangular policy. Geometry/work/output remain bounded. Existing appearances retain precedence and original BBox/annotation placement is unchanged.
requirements.status: implemented; 44 authored controls and 40 independent pixel expectations; current stroke/dash additions await hosted validation
requirements.gaps: Conic/rectangle integrals validate fills and circular offsets. Independently bounded true ellipse normals and exact circular arclengths add unequal-axis stroke and circular dash expectations; their hosted accuracy gate remains open. Elliptical dashes, wider border combinations and nonrectangular legacy radii remain open. Filled forms share the geometry; relief/cloudy controls have dedicated requirements. requirements.status: Shared source/preview/save implementation and independent controls authored after hosted baseline observations; product runtime validation pending
requirements.rule: Variable-text widgets use effective FT, Ff, V, DA, Q and MaxLen, with null dictionary entries treated as absent. AcroForm supplies DA/DR; MK remains widget-local. A bounded requested-widget view checks Parent ancestry and forward Fields/Kids membership, shares the full form owner's inheritance, terminal-field and value readers, and omits unrelated field subtrees, names, actions and DV. Unnamed separate widgets use their owning field's attributes. Source and explicit edit inputs feed one generator and the existing font/layout, style, resource, MK rotation and appearance serialization owners. Choice V identifies displayed Opt names (the second string of an export/display pair); I is used when consistent with authoritative V and TI selects the first visible row. Ordinary stored AP wins regardless of NeedAppearances. Untouched missing Tx/Ch previews generate from source values; an explicit specification form preview/save can regenerate when NeedAppearances is true, retaining the existing Tx replacement/append rules. Hidden and text-only requests do not inspect field data. No-op ordinary saves preserve bytes; explicit preparation and same-value saves are checked through strict reopen against independent Type3 rectangle coverage. A present AP dictionary requires N (Table 170); null N is absent under 7.3.9 and is a Syntax error, whereas optional AP=null permits generation.
requirements.gaps: The 47 pixel controls and source/preview/save checks passed at retained 5321c0958 (hosted runs 40392132368, 40392132561 and 40392132510); the 28 raw adapter observations establish scoped reader behavior, not pixel truth or family support. Rich/CID/complex-script layout, actions and physical printing remain separate boundaries; normal button artwork is covered by content-normal-button-display. Source display does not execute the NeedAppearances request or normalize malformed field membership; full form inspection retains its existing repair contract. No whole-tree cache, timing claim or V01/V02 promotion is introduced. Hosted editing run 40389416478 exposed an incorrect new null-N pixel expectation; primary Table 170 adjudication reclassified that same PDF as Syntax. Product code and the previous 416 pixel controls are unchanged; 47 valid widget pixel controls remain. Empty Tx/Sig geometry uses the shared ancestry/membership proof without selecting DA, DR, XFA or text-fit rules. Complete field inspection and form editing retain their original validation.

requirements.rule: Generate rubber-stamp appearances for all fourteen standard Name values, using Draft for absent/null/custom names by documented reader policy. IT defaults to Stamp; image/snapshot/unknown intents require stored artwork. Validate name/intent types and finite geometry before empty-color suppression. Reader artwork uses a red (or C) rectangular frame and centred uppercase Helvetica-Bold/WinAnsi through the configured font provider. Frame width is the smaller Rect dimension divided by 32; text padding is that dimension divided by 8 and the font size fits both available dimensions using AFM advances and ascent/descent. Frame uses CA and text ca (else CA). Fonts live in private appearance resources; stored appearances retain precedence. Fixed label storage, font-map/layout work, frame geometry and generated content stay bounded.
requirements.status: implemented with 38 controls and 33 independent pixel expectations; hosted native/WASI/client/viewer and Windows/Ubuntu checks pass at 05dd8d1db; final platform/report checks pending
requirements.gaps: Artwork is reader policy, not standardized pixels. The font oracle independently reads pinned TrueType points and integrates the original quadratics analytically using binary64 edge roots and Green integrals, with analytic controls for clipping, holes, reversal and subdivision. The existing straight-only oracle retains its rational path. Builds without font data report font.non-embedded. Image/snapshot artwork cannot be synthesized from absent content; its stored-appearance path remains supported. Popup/activation workflows are separate from this normal appearance.

requirements.status: FixedPrint screen placement and original Sound fallback/explicit-view controls passed the retained 386-control hosted render and native/WASI/client/save-reopen checks
requirements.rule: Sound static drawing is distinct from playback. Speaker and Mic are recommended predefined icons and an absent Name defaults to Speaker; exact artwork is reader policy. The original Speaker/Mic symbols share the bounded Text/FileAttachment icon owner. Ordinary Sound placement scales and rotates with the page; explicit NoZoom/NoRotate flags use the existing view contract. This static policy follows matched MuPDF/Poppler observations; DPI export does not establish full-viewer zoom behavior. Text keeps its explicit fixed-icon rule. Existing normal appearances win over malformed substitute-artwork entries and provide authored drawing controls without reading Sound or action payloads. On-screen Watermark FixedPrint uses the displayed MediaBox as media: translate Rect to the origin, apply Matrix, fit AP to the upright enclosing rectangle and apply media-relative H/V displacement. The existing NoRotate view cancels page rotation at the media anchor. Nonzero media origins are restored; CropBox clips the placed result. UserUnit remains the default user-space unit size and ordinary display zoom remains in force. Absent or null FixedPrint retains ordinary annotation placement. Type is required; Matrix and H/V default to identity and zero, including null optional entries. References use existing depth limits and all resulting coordinates must remain finite. Hidden and text-only requests do not read placement data.
requirements.gaps: FixedPrint physical print media, fit-to-paper scaling, printer margins, tiling and n-up remain V05 adapter/contract gaps. Speaker/Mic artwork has no universal pixel oracle; original geometric symbols are independently checked, not copied from readers. Matched missing/stored Sound and Text inputs at 72/144 DPI, Rotate0/90 and explicit flags record scoped adapter behavior separately from pixel verdicts. Unknown Sound icon names use Speaker by reader policy. Interaction and playback remain V03 gaps; static painting never reads sound or action payloads. Current baseline adapters use display only; PDF.js omits its HTML annotation layer and Quartz omits PDFKit, so these configurations cannot establish full-viewer icon support or interactive zoom semantics. This requirement does not promote the V01 family.

requirements.status: Static source implementation and independent controls; hosted acceptance pending
requirements.rule: Screen with absent/null AP has no default artwork, including when MK/I exists. Explicit Movie Poster image streams remain source references executed by ordinary image Do in a generated Form. Rotate is clockwise in quarter turns; fitting the image to Rect is reader policy, since Aspect specifies movie pixel dimensions without a poster fit algorithm. Absent/null/false Poster draws nothing and true refuses movie-file retrieval. The image has private resources: its ColorSpace is a direct PDF object under 8.6.3, not a page resource name. 3D, RichMedia, PrinterMark and TrapNet require normal AP; missing/null artwork is Syntax, while stored streams/state selection precede generation and unused payloads remain inert. Existing hidden, text-only, AP/N malformed, reference, image-pixel, program and scene budgets remain in force.
requirements.gaps: This is static display, not media activation, movie-file poster extraction, 3D rendering or print production. Image codec/colour/mask support remains with the ordinary image pipeline (groups 03/05); richer font/layout and form edits belong to groups 04/07, host interactions/media to group 08, physical print to group 10 and sanitizing redaction to group 16. This finite source checkpoint is not full V01 acceptance or a competitor-viewer claim.

requirements.rule: Generate Highlight, Underline, StrikeOut and Squiggly from finite, convex counterclockwise QuadPoints, resolving indirect arrays and numbers. The first edge defines the text direction. Reader artwork policy fills Highlight quads with Multiply, uses a bottom 1/12-height underline, a centred 1/12-height strikeout and a 1/24-height zigzag ribbon with alternating peaks 1/12 apart and horizontal steps at most height/6. All quads share one nonzero fill, so their overlap does not reapply opacity. C and ca (else CA) style the generated marks under the original annotation BBox. Absent C defaults to yellow for Highlight and black for the other subtypes. Geometry, work, temporary storage and content remain bounded before empty-color suppression. Stored appearances retain precedence. Top-left/top-right/bottom-left/bottom-right QuadPoints are reordered only under reported annotation.quad-order recovery; Strict rendering refuses that repair. Validated zero-area quads emit no marks instead of invoking PDF empty-fill hairline behavior.
